name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport was a happy accident. Originally trained as a chef in Montreal, he found himself catering a small regional rally event in Quebec. The energy and passion of the teams hooked him instantly. He began volunteering, then working part-time, eventually transitioning fully into motorsport catering. His deep understanding of culinary techniques, combined with his experience working in high-pressure restaurant environments, makes him uniquely suited to the logistical challenges of feeding a racing team. 

Jean-Pierre's approach to catering is rooted in providing nutritious and delicious meals that fuel performance. He believes in using fresh, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible, and he's always experimenting with new recipes and dietary strategies to optimize the team's energy levels. What sets him apart is his ability to adapt to the ever-changing demands of the motorsport world, ensuring that the team is well-fed and ready to perform, no matter where they are in the world.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre has a stocky build and a perpetually friendly smile.

quirks: Always has a small notepad to jot down recipe ideas, even during races.
Insists on starting every day with a strong cup of espresso.
Secretly taste-tests every dish, no matter how many times he's made it.
